summary: A Telegram contact claiming to provide cryptocurrency assistance instructed the victim to withdraw assets from Binance to a wallet address under the scammer's control. The scammer impersonated or claimed to be a well known individual to gain trust before stealing the funds.
user_mistake: Sent cryptocurrency to a wallet address provided by an unverified Telegram contact
prevention: Send cryptocurrency only to wallet addresses you independently control or verify / Ignore investment or financial assistance offered by strangers on messaging platforms
